dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast white horizontal band of moderate thickness visible across the mid-wing coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp pale boundaries along the margins of dark-centered folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Distinct rectangular white patch on the central nape, exhibiting high contrast against adjacent black plumage.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, linear color transition boundary between the black crown and yellowish-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Broad white auricular patch and yellowish ventral plumage.
